nodes.name: 2 nm Ag NP on Au support

nodes.characterization_summary: DPFT-calibrated PZCs: hemispherical Ag NP (-0.522 V vs. SHE), 2 nm Ag NP (-0.478 V vs. SHE), planar Ag support (-0.435 V vs. SHE), planar Au support (0.193 V vs. SHE), Au NP (-0.03 V vs. SHE).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The PZC of the 2 nm Ag NP and the planar Au support are -0.478 V_SHE and 0.193 V_SHE, respectively. ... The PZC for Au NP and Ag support are -0.03 V_SHE and -0.435 V_SHE, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Effective proton concentration over RP for Ag NP on Au support is roughly twice that on Ag support at 100 mM bulk concentration, increasing to >5-fold at 1 mM.
nodes.evidence_snippet: At 100 mM, \overline{c_{H^+}^{RP}} of Ag NPs supported on Au is roughly twice as large as on Ag ... In contrast, at 1 mM, the difference increases markedly, from a 2-fold to a more than 5-fold variation.

nodes.name: 2 nm Ag NP on Au support

nodes.characterization_summary: DPFT shows smaller 1 nm Ag NPs on Au support have higher average proton concentration at RP than 2 nm Ag NPs due to stronger EDL overlap effect.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As indicated by the diamond markers in Figure 3b and d, the average proton concentration is higher for smaller NP. This reversal is attributed to the EDL overlap effect...
